text: APPROVE. `BuildPlan` drops to roughly 7 cognitive complexity, and the extracted helpers preserve the original logic: parameter-order check order, the skip when neither parameter is the document, and the captured method and `returnsDocument` semantics. The `is var (eventIndex, documentIndex)` pattern on a nullable tuple fails on null and definitely assigns both variables, so it should compile cleanly. I couldn't run the build, so the one residual risk is a style analyzer objecting to the `const` placed between methods.
